claim_text: In Protocol v5 confirmatory evaluation, ACA achieves statistical parity with partial re-auctioning (CBBA-PR+LR: 92.40% vs 93.39%).
Pinsker claim margin reduces safe conflicts by ~10.3 conflicts/trial relative to no-margin ablation (39.66 vs 49.93, p < 0.001) in v5.
Pinsker margin incurs a modest non-significant completion cost of ~1.08 pp (92.40% vs 93.48%, p = 0.091) in v5.
CTP Replan achieves higher completion than ACA on the balanced core grid (96.4% vs 90.9%) due to continuous reactive replanning without consensus deferrals.
